_comment: GET /v2/events/next. The endpoint may return a SINGLE OBJECT or an ARRAY of events. A 404 means 'no upcoming events' and is NOT an error. See the EventType value list under POST /v2/events in endpoints.md.
Name: Ironman Kona

_gotchas.Pr_is_a_boolean: GoalType 'Pr' carries Value: true/false, a boolean - not a number like the other goal types.
_gotchas.goal_units: Distance goals are typically in Miles, Time goals in Hours; Place and Pr have Unit: null.
_gotchas.workout_ids_int64: WorkoutIds are Int64 identifiers of workouts linked to the event.
